en: A monochrome image showing a Gothic stone façade with two large crowned statues of royals or saints set in niches high on the wall. Each figure stands on a carved console beneath an ornate canopy of miniature pinnacles and arches. Below them is a pointed, richly moulded Gothic doorway with tracery and a heavy studded wooden door. The architectural style is late medieval/early Renaissance Central European Gothic.
